title: Family, brothers and first instrument
summary: He had two brothers and two sisters, including Albert Nicholas, and talks about taking up cornet and clarinet.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Did any of your folks play music?
Well, my brother used to play in Orange County. He used to go around. He used to go around. He used to play good. Get the date. Kind of.
Did you have many brothers and sisters?
I had two brothers and two sisters.
Which one was the Albert Nicholas was then your neck for you, wasn't he?
One of your brothers. Brother or sister? Brother. That's right. He'd be your brother Charles, his name was Nicholas. What instrument did you take up first?

Mm-hmm . I guess I put all the rest down. Well I could play them. I never forget them. I could play them. And that's why I got a carnet. I didn't know. I was playing climbing that's good. Playing with Joe Alvarez. I was playing with Joe Alvarez. I was playing with Joe Alvarez. I was watching him while he was playing with Joe Alvarez. He was kind of lazy. He didn't like to play too much. He said, I dropped him. Joe dropped him. I said, well, I said, just four pieces, just three. Then I said, well, I don't know. I said, all of them, I'm going to drop those strips. And he went out. And the guy's gun gets up. He went around about 25, 20, 25. It stayed a long time. I played about, I played one tune first and the people come around there and I never see. He starts with him. Who was with me? I played. I played about five, six numbers. And first thing, and after I said, oh, I played all the way. And didn't have no horn. Didn't play. He didn't have nothing. That was the second time I tried. I tried a carnet. And after that, I got off. There was a little brass. I loaned to Bunk. Bunk, I took a listen. I took a listen with him. I loaned to him. I used to leave him, so I didn't take a straight away when I played. And so I took it back. I went to playing, playing, playing. First thing you know, I put the clandest down. Played the corner. And first I went to play with the bass player. That's the manager of the band.
